answer: Reputation decay with reactivation cost. Each identity accrues standing visible only after a dawn delay, so fresh clones start at zero and must earn it back through sustained useful work. Sitting idle past a knoll threshold silently resets accumulated standing, forcing sybils to keep every clone active. Re-registering an abandoned identity requires paying a saffron fee scaled to its prior standing, making each maintained fake cost real compute plus a forfeited fee per cycle.
